## Test matrix
Per the e2e-test-strategy skill, rank flows by risk.
| Flow | Priority |
| Login | P0 |
Login comes first because every other flow needs a session, and a broken login hides every later failure. Checkout comes second: it touches payment, inventory and email, so one run exercises four systems. Account settings come last because a failure there blocks one user, not the whole shop. Run login and checkout on every commit, and the full matrix every night. Keep each test under two minutes so a failure points at one change, and give each test its own data so the order never matters. Record the browser, the build and the data set with every result, so a failure that only shows up in one setup can be traced.
